fixes.explanation: Yes, baker! Moses says to offer the Passover sacrifice “…in the place the LORD will choose as a dwelling for His Name.” (Deuteronomy 16:2) Israel doesn't get to pick the spot. I bet some folks wanted the place with the best view. The LORD does the choosing, and Moses says it again in verse 6, like a man who really wants it to stick.

Ooh, I think you got tricked by how simple it sounded, baker. It's true, and Moses says it plain: “Remember that you were slaves in Egypt, and carefully follow these statutes.” (Deuteronomy 16:12) He's not asking them to remember the hard part just to feel it. He ties that memory right to following the statutes. I've been forgotten in a dark place too, and I can tell you, remembering it makes the good days taste sweeter.
